tailwindcss.README.txt:
Sukoaa Tailwind CSS 4.2.1 starter — Node 20+.
Run npm install, then npm run build.
Open public/index.html in a browser. npm run dev watches for changes.
The built output.css can be deployed as a static asset. The Sukoaa browser
lab uses the Tailwind browser package for practice only. Use this CLI build
for production instead of a runtime browser compiler.

fastapi.README.txt:
Sukoaa FastAPI starter — Python 3.10+.
Create a virtual environment: python -m venv .venv
Activate on Windows PowerShell: .venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
On macOS/Linux: source .venv/bin/activate
Install: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
Test: python -m unittest -v
Start: python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
Open http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs for interactive API documentation.
Routes: /health, /products, /products/1; POST /products simulates creation.
This is a local Python server, not the browser Python snippet compiler.
No real records, authentication or production persistence are included.

postgresql.compose.yaml:
name: sukoaa-postgres-learning
services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:17
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: learner
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: local-learning-only
      POSTGRES_DB: sukoaa_learning
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:5433:5432"
    volumes:
      - learning-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./schema.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/01-schema.sql:ro
volumes:
  learning-data:
postgresql.schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE products (id integer GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, title text NOT NULL, price integer NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0), stock integer NOT NULL CHECK (stock >= 0), metadata jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb);
INSERT INTO products (title, price, stock, metadata) VALUES ('Notebook',12,5,'{"color":"green"}'),('Lamp',35,2,'{"color":"white"}'),('Bag',24,0,'{"color":"blue"}');
postgresql.README.txt:
Sukoaa PostgreSQL starter — Docker with a PostgreSQL 17 container.
Run: docker compose up -d
Connect: docker compose exec postgres psql -U learner -d sukoaa_learning
Inside psql: \i /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/01-schema.sql is NOT needed on a
fresh volume: Docker runs it on first initialisation. Explore with \dt.
Run the queries in exercises.sql. Stop with docker compose down.
The named volume retains your local data. Do not use these demo credentials
for production. Port 5433 is bound to loopback only.
The Sukoaa browser lab uses PGlite, a single-connection WebAssembly build
of PostgreSQL. It is separate from this full Docker database and from
Sukoaa's existing SQLite compiler. Not every server extension is bundled.

nodejs.README.txt:
Sukoaa Node.js HTTP starter (Node 22+; tested with Node 24).
No npm packages are needed. Run npm test, then npm start.
Open http://localhost:3000/health or /api/products?inStock=true.
POST /api/echo accepts JSON up to 8,000 bytes. Nothing is persisted.
This is a teaching API without authentication, not a production service.
The optional Sukoaa browser Node lab uses WebContainers; provider browser
support, network access and applicable licence terms still apply.

laravel.README.txt:
Sukoaa Laravel 13 API learning starter — local setup required.
Requirements: PHP 8.3+ with Laravel-required extensions, Composer 2.
1. composer install
2. Copy .env.example to .env (PowerShell: Copy-Item .env.example .env).
3. php artisan key:generate
4. composer test
5. php artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8003
Try GET /api/products, GET /api/products/1 and POST /api/products.
Send Accept: application/json and Content-Type: application/json.
POST validates title and a positive price, returns 201 and persisted:false.
This minimal teaching app uses fictional data and no database or auth.
The browser route compiler is available separately at /labs/laravel.
This download is a local teaching starter, not a production application.

<?php
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
Route::get('/products', function () { return ['data'=>[['id'=>1,'title'=>'Notebook','price'=>12],['id'=>2,'title'=>'Lamp','price'=>35]]]; });
Route::get('/products/{id}', function (string $id) { abort_unless(in_array($id,['1','2'],true),404); return ['id'=>(int)$id,'title'=>$id==='1'?'Notebook':'Lamp']; })->whereNumber('id');
Route::post('/products', function (Request $request) { $data=$request->validate(['title'=>['required','string','max:120'],'price'=>['required','numeric','gt:0']]); return response()->json(['data'=>['id'=>3,...$data],'persisted'=>false],201); });

 public function test_index(): void { $this->getJson('/api/products')->assertOk()->assertJsonCount(2,'data'); }
 public function test_missing(): void { $this->getJson('/api/products/99')->assertNotFound(); }

php.lib.php:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
function demo_handle(string $method, string $path, array $query, string $raw = ''): array {
    $products = [['id'=>1,'title'=>'Notebook','stock'=>5],['id'=>2,'title'=>'Lamp','stock'=>2],['id'=>3,'title'=>'Bag','stock'=>0]];
    if ($method === 'GET' && $path === '/health') return [200, ['ok'=>true]];
    if ($method === 'GET' && $path === '/products') {
        if (isset($query['in_stock']) && !in_array($query['in_stock'], ['true','false'], true)) return [400,['error'=>'Use in_stock=true or false']];
        $rows = isset($query['in_stock']) ? array_filter($products, fn($p) => ($p['stock'] > 0) === ($query['in_stock'] === 'true')) : $products;
        return [200,['data'=>array_values($rows)]];
    }
    if ($method === 'POST' && $path === '/echo') {
        if (strlen($raw) > 8000) return [413,['error'=>'Body too large']];
        try { $data = json_decode($raw, false, 32, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR); }
        catch (JsonException $e) { return [400,['error'=>'Invalid JSON']]; }
        if (!is_object($data)) return [422,['error'=>'Send a JSON object']];
        return [200,['data'=>$data,'persisted'=>false]];
    }
    return [404,['error'=>'Not found']];
}

<?php
require __DIR__.'/lib.php';
function check(bool $ok, string $message): void { if (!$ok) throw new RuntimeException($message); }
check(demo_handle('GET','/health',[])[1]['ok'] === true, 'health');
check(count(demo_handle('GET','/products',['in_stock'=>'true'])[1]['data']) === 2, 'filter');
check(demo_handle('POST','/echo',[], '{broken')[0] === 400, 'invalid JSON');
check(demo_handle('POST','/echo',[], '[]')[0] === 422, 'object shape');
check(demo_handle('GET','/missing',[])[0] === 404, 'not found');
echo "5 PHP checks passed\n";
php.README.txt:
Sukoaa PHP starter — PHP 8.3+ CLI.
Test: php tests.php
Start: php -S 127.0.0.1:8002 router.php
Try /health, /products?in_stock=true, POST /echo with a JSON object.
No Composer dependencies or database are required. Writes are simulated.
PHP's built-in server is for local development, not production hosting.
The website provides guided exercises and this source download; it does
not execute a native PHP server in the browser.
